description: This file defines the PHP class VendorTheme within the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Model.Checkout. It contains methods to retrieve voucher theme data from the database, including fetching a specific voucher theme by ID and a list of voucher themes with filter options.

classes.name: VoucherTheme
classes.description: Represents the model for voucher themes, providing methods to fetch voucher theme data from the database.

methods.name: getVoucherTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a voucher theme by its ID, returning an associative array of its properties.

methods.name: getVoucherThemes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of voucher themes filtered and sorted based on provided criteria, returning an array of voucher theme data.
